svg.title: Day shift and after hours
svg.desc: A 24-hour dial split between a sun and a moon. Day shift: Web Developer, UTA Office of IT. Research Assistant, Robotic Vision Lab. Undergraduate Representative, UTA CSE Student Advisory Council. After hours: wandering places from Niagara Falls to the Rocky Mountains, writing things that don't fit on a résumé, and worldbuilding, fluent in Westeros and shaky on Earth.
svg.text: things that don't fit on a résumé
